No entrance lettering, signs, plaques or information boards. An adult and a child seen from behind on a zoo path watching two giraffes across a low rail and a clear gap. A sparse acacia and ochre rocks inside the enclosure. Elevated wide view, full giraffes including hooves and heads, all figures in plain clothes and plain slip-on shoes. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background, show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. IMPORTANT: zoom the composition OUT. Leave roughly ONE SIXTH of canvas width on both the left and right and generous WHITE space above and below. No object or person's extremity touches an edge. No border. Absolutely no text, lettering, digits, writing or pseudo-writing, labels, watermarks, brand marks, logos or emblems anywhere. One clear composition.
